about_the_game:
Creatures — Live. Observe. Survive.

Step into a wild, untamed island where life thrives… and danger lurks in every shadow.

Creatures is a third-person survival game, set in a dynamic, prehistoric ecosystem where every creature follows its own instincts, routines, and survival rules. Explore a vast open world with diverse biomes — from dense jungles and calm shores to murky swamps and snowy peaks — where the balance between predator and prey defines the rhythm of life.

Face the wilderness. Read the signs. Survive the perfect balance of beauty and danger.

🌿 A living ecosystem
Interact with a world where every creature breathes, hunts, sleeps, and reacts to its surroundings. Nothing is static — the world lives with or without you.

🌙 Day/Night cycle and dynamic weather
The rules change with the light. Fog hides. Darkness hunts. Creatures behave differently depending on the time and climate.

🐾 Unscripted animal encounters
Witness or survive natural confrontations: a Spinosaurus roaring under the moon, crocodiles dragging prey into murky waters, or titanic beasts clashing over territory.

🌎 Limitless exploration
Roam beautiful yet treacherous lands: coastal trails, dense forests, dangerous wetlands, and frozen mountains full of hidden stories.

🤝 Optional multiplayer
Survive alone… or explore together. Hunt, observe, or simply experience a world that feels alive — with or without you.

In Creatures, you're not the hero. You're part of the ecosystem.

Every sound has meaning. Every shadow hides a lesson.

There are no quests. Only survival.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Intel i3-9100 / Ryzen 3 3200G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050Ti 4GB / RX 560 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The minimum requirements are designed for a smooth experience on low settings at 720p. For a full visual experience at 1080p or higher, it is recommended to meet the recommended system requirements.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K o AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 Ti o AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
